video_title: Is Jalen Brunson the Greatest Knick EVER If He Wins?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Is Jalen Brunson the greatest Knick ever if he wins?
quotes.excerpt: If he wins a championship, he's the greatest Knick.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: If he wins a championship, he's the greatest Knick. Clyde Frazier won two championships and has been a part of the Knicks organization, first-ballot Hall of Famer. Clyde Frazier is one of those dudes. I don't know what you're smirking at, but we'll figure it out later.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: And I don't want to say modern-day basketball like it wasn't modern-day, but he might be the greatest Knick in the last 40 years. You can't just erase what these dudes did. If you look at the numbers that he put up, one of them was in a Game 7.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Jalen Brunson's status as an all-time great
quotes.excerpt: He's probably ranked top three for all-time playoff wins in Knick history.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: He's probably ranked top three for all-time playoff wins in Knick history. He's probably top three in points per game in the playoffs. So that's that. And then let's talk about this run. OG Anunoby, who one could argue is more valuable to the Knicks than any other player in the league, might be the most valuable piece to his organization.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: OG Anunoby goes out, no problem. Jalen Brunson is right on to Philly, lead them, probably have averaged a quiet 28 for his playoff career in Philly, though, by the way, he's averaging damn near 35.

quotes.speaker: Allie Clifton
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's impact on his teammates and the Knicks organization
quotes.excerpt: I'm mesmerized by the way this team is playing. In fact, I'm living vicariously through them.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: Early in May, Jalen Brunson was on Jimmy Fallon and he said, 'I'm mesmerized by the way this team is playing. In fact, I'm living vicariously through them. They remind me of my team.'

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: When the facts change, so will my opinion. I tell people that all the time. All the stupid people that want to get out there, 'You said this, you said that.' It's like, listen, when the facts change, so does my opinion.
